# Level-1 walker plant

> **Status:** 4 faults × 4 configurations × 2 slopes = 32 cases, 22 ending in a mishap; without a fault the walker stands to 25° and tips at 30°. Synthetic, **no evidence credit**.

## Purpose

A reduced-order model of SUS-M1 in the sagittal plane: a point mass on a force-controlled leg, balanced by capture-point feedback, with the actuator capacity, load-holding, pilot alarm and protective stop the hazards depend on. It runs each fault with its mitigations present and absent, so the table shows what each mitigation buys under the stated assumptions. It ranks risks and guides tests; it never closes a hazard. Standard library only and deterministic.

## What each fault realises

![Figure 2 · What each fault realises](assets/sim/plant/figures/fig-2-fault-trace.svg)

| Fault | Injection | Causal factors |
|---|---|---|
| FLT-01 Hydraulic supply pressure loss | supply fraction decays exponentially to zero from onset with time constant tau_leak_s | HAZ-SAF-001:CF2, HAZ-WLK-002:CF4, HAZ-PIL-002:CF1 |
| FLT-02 Posture feedback frozen (stale) | controller reads the CoM state frozen at onset | HAZ-WLK-001:CF1, HAZ-WLK-001:CF3 |
| FLT-03 Protective stop commands zero torque | a protective stop requested at onset removes leg force and ankle torque instead of the mode-specific stop | HAZ-SAF-001:CF1 |
| FLT-04 Electric bus undervoltage | torque capacity decays to electric_sag_floor from onset with time constant tau_leak_s | HAZ-SAF-001:CF2, HAZ-WLK-002:CF4, HAZ-PIL-002:CF1 |

## Assumptions

Stated in [`walker.py`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/sim/plant/walker.py); every result holds only under them.

| # | Assumption |
|---|---|
| A1 | Sagittal plane only. The body is a point mass on a massless telescopic leg: a linear inverted pendulum horizontally (x = CoM offset from the support centre, + downhill), a force-controlled leg vertically (z). |
| A2 | In single support the gait moves the CoM reference as x_ref = stride_offset + slope_lean * z * tan(slope) + sway_amplitude * sin(2 pi t / sway_period): the slope_lean fraction of the slope-induced lean is not compensated by the gait, and the CoM sways over the stance foot as the walker walks. |
| A3 | The balance controller places the centre of pressure p by capture-point feedback. p is limited to +/- L * c, where L is the support half-length (foot, or stance after the swing foot is planted) projected on the horizontal and c the actuator capacity fraction (supply pressure or bus voltage, 0..1). |
| A4 | Leg force is limited to leg_force_ratio * m * g * c. The structure rests at crouch_height; arriving there faster than safe_drop_speed is a hard drop. |
| A5 | Load-holding valves (hydraulic) or brakes (electric) engage after lock_delay once c < lock_threshold, if they work. Locked, the body is rigid: it stays if its capture point is inside the geometric support, otherwise it rotates about the support edge. |
| A6 | The pilot hears the low-supply alarm (c < low_supply_alarm) and requests a protective stop after pilot_reaction_s. The correct (mode-specific) stop plants the swing foot (step_time), then crouches at crouch_rate. Stale feedback raises no alarm; the staleness monitor, if fitted, engages the hold. A case may also request a stop directly (stop_request_s), as an operator would. |
| A7 | Tipping is irrecoverable beyond tip_offset. Contact, rotation after tipping and terrain compliance are not modelled; the run stops at the first mishap. |
| A8 | A case starts in mid-gait on the periodic orbit of the unsaturated balance loop (initial_state): the CoM at the gait's mean offset plus the loop's own sway response, not at the reference sway with the reference velocity. Starting on the reference put the capture point up to 0.3 m ahead of the CoM, a state the gait never reaches, and tipped edge cases with no fault (resolved with the level-2 cross-check, sim/results/l2-crosscheck.md). |

## Boundary diagram

![Figure 4 · Boundary diagram](assets/sim/plant/figures/fig-4-boundary-diagram.svg)

| # | From | To | Crossing / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fault catalogue | Plant model | faults, causal factors |
| 2 | Hazard records | Fault catalogue | causal factors to realise |
| 3 | Plant spec | Plant model | parameters (checked: unit, range, source) |
| 4 | Plant model | Committed results | plant-results.json and .md |
| 5 | Walker plant | Failure search | the same model, sampled |
| 6 | Walker plant | Level-2 cross-check | outcomes to compare with MuJoCo |
| 7 | Committed results | Simulation figures and pages | scenes, wiki page |
| 8 | CI | Walker plant | --check: results must reproduce |
| 9 | Walker plant | Safety lead | findings for review |

**Explicitly excluded:** lateral dynamics, contact and rotation after a mishap, terrain compliance, the UAV and any design value (A1, A7).

## SysML model

[`WalkerPlant.sysml`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/sim/plant/WalkerPlant.sysml) is generated from the spec and validated with the project model by the OMG pilot in CI.

![Figure 5 · SysML block definition — WalkerPlant](assets/sim/plant/figures/fig-5-sysml-block-definition.svg)

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Range | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mass_kg` | 3000 | kg | 1500 to 6000 | assumed | Concept scale: open-frame walker with protected operator station (README) |
| `com_height_m` | 3.0 | m | 2.0 to 4.5 | assumed | Concept scale; CoM roughly at hip height of a ~5 m walker |
| `crouch_height_m` | 1.8 | m | 1.0 to 2.5 | assumed | Kneeling/supported posture (CONOPS MOD-03 stable pose) |
| `foot_half_length_m` | 0.6 | m | 0.3 to 1.0 | assumed | Single-support foot, along the direction of travel |
| `stance_half_length_m` | 1.4 | m | 0.8 to 2.5 | assumed | Double-support polygon after planting the swing foot |
| `tip_offset_m` | 1.0 | m | 0.6 to 2.0 | assumed | CoM horizontal offset beyond which tipping is taken as irrecoverable (contact and rotation not modelled) |
| `leg_force_ratio` | 2.0 | - | 1.2 to 4.0 | assumed | Leg actuator peak force as a multiple of body weight at full supply |
| `step_time_s` | 0.5 | s | 0.2 to 1.5 | assumed | Time to plant the swing foot when a protective stop starts |
| `crouch_rate_mps` | 0.3 | m/s | 0.1 to 1.0 | assumed | Commanded descent rate to the crouch posture during a protective stop |
| `safe_drop_speed_mps` | 1.0 | m/s | 0.5 to 3.0 | assumed | Vertical cockpit impact speed treated as injurious to a restrained seated pilot; placeholder pending HHA (Task 207) |
| `slope_lean` | 0.25 | - | 0.0 to 1.0 | assumed | Fraction of the slope-induced CoM lean (z tan slope) the gait does not compensate |
| `sway_amplitude_m` | 0.1 | m | 0.0 to 0.4 | assumed | CoM fore-aft sway over the stance foot while walking |
| `sway_period_s` | 1.2 | s | 0.6 to 3.0 | assumed | Gait cycle period at walking pace |
| `balance_gain` | 1.5 | - | 0.5 to 5.0 | assumed | Capture-point feedback gain |
| `height_kp` | 25.0 | 1/s2 | 5 to 100 | assumed | Height loop stiffness |
| `height_kd` | 10.0 | 1/s | 2 to 40 | assumed | Height loop damping |
| `low_supply_alarm` | 0.7 | - | 0.3 to 0.95 | assumed | Supply fraction that raises the pilot alarm |
| `lock_threshold` | 0.4 | - | 0.1 to 0.8 | assumed | Supply fraction below which load-holding valves or brakes engage (HAZ-SAF-001 M1) |
| `lock_delay_s` | 0.1 | s | 0.0 to 1.0 | assumed | Engagement delay of load-holding valves or brakes |
| `monitor_detect_s` | 0.15 | s | 0.01 to 1.0 | assumed | Feedback staleness monitor detection time (SSF-004); no design yet |
| `electric_sag_floor` | 0.35 | - | 0.0 to 0.9 | assumed | Electric variant: residual torque capacity after a bus undervoltage |
| `dt_s` | 0.005 | s | 0.001 to 0.01 | assumed | Integration step (semi-implicit Euler) |
| `horizon_s` | 6.0 | s | 3 to 20 | assumed | Simulated time after the start of the case |
| `gravity_mps2` | 9.81 | m/s2 | 9.8 to 9.82 | published | Standard gravity |
